text:
clare-people-ops: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up thread for All-Hands Qs about travel, offsites, and workspace policies. I’ll consolidate answers here and drop links. 

jess-engineering: Awesome, thanks. Quick one — is there a cap on domestic flight class for offsites? economy vs premium economy?

clare-people-ops: Short answer: economy for <5hr flights, premium economy allowed for 5-8hr with manager pre-approval, business only in exceptional cases and requires exec ok + finance signoff. Full guidance + examples here: https://intranet.redwood/pay-travel (we'll add to handbook)

mike-ops: For dedicated teams doing recurring travel (eg quarterly on-site), ask your manager to request a travel budget line in the next planning cycle. That makes approvals faster.

lucy-remote: Are we still covering commuting to a satellite office for people who live nearby?

clare-people-ops: Yes — commuting to a satellite office for a scheduled team day is reimbursable up to the public transit cap or ride-share cap (same as previous policy). If you're driving, submit mileage via Expense form, include route screenshot.

dmitri: What's the timeline for the desk reservation pilot you mentioned? Any instructions?

clare-people-ops: Pilot starts Mon next week in SF hub. Steps: 1) go to https://workspace.redwood/reserve 2) pick a desk zone (team zones prioritized) 3) reserve up to 3 days/week during pilot. We're collecting feedback in the pilot form link on that page. Expect a Slack DM from the pilot bot.

jess-engineering: Will there be guaranteed seating for heads-down days when we need it?

mike-ops: Not guaranteed during pilot — we’re testing prioritization rules (team zones, recurring booking for on-call, and manager-allocated seats). If you need guaranteed space for a critical day, ping your manager and ops and we’ll try to reserve.

lucy-remote: Offsite parental leave coverage question — if someone travels after returning from leave, is there any special approval window?

clare-people-ops: We encourage a 4-week buffer after parental leave for long travel; exceptions handled case-by-case with manager + People Ops. Safety & flexibility are priorities.

jess-engineering: Expense submission question — can we submit multi-leg itineraries as one report or separate?

expense-bot: You can upload the whole itinerary as one report. Tag each leg in the description (LEG1, LEG2) and attach receipts. If reimbursement spans two cost centers, split the report per cost center.

anna-ceo: Thanks @clare-people-ops for leading this. Quick roadmap note: we want 1) clearer travel SLAs, 2) easier desk booking, 3) offsite playbook by Q3. Will share draft playbook in next week’s notes.

clare-people-ops: Will update this thread with links to the handbook, reservation pilot FAQ, and the offsite playbook draft. If you have follow-ups tag me or drop them here. :thumbsup:
